definitions.supplemental: v. Archiv lxxix. 24, 31: Sé bið þeóf and sceaðe. See note to the passage, and cf.: Hé is þeóf and sceaða, Jn. 10, 1.

source_text: þeóf-sceaþa, an; m. A robber; latro :-- Sé bið þeófsceaþa, Lch. iii. 158, 12. [v. Archiv lxxix. 24, 31: Sé bið þeóf and sceaðe. See note to the passage, and cf.: Hé is þeóf and sceaða, Jn. 10, 1.]
